Capture byte and timestamp manifests before changes, and coordinate bounded watcher suspension during incomplete mapped-source edits.

### Risks

- A stale baseline or running source watcher can publish incomplete assets; preserve current owners and restore only the previously observed service state.

### Acceptance criteria

- The exact plan revision, TRD digest, root identity, execution authority and source/destination boundary are recorded.
- The baseline records unrelated edits, existing Task/TRD/plan history, product files and watcher state; absent services are not installed.

### Planned verification

- Re-run read-only Task/role/plan status, inspect live native tools/settings and compare the source TRD digest.
- Run template_update.py check and snapshot governed bytes/mtimes; identify the execution-owned files explicitly.

## TASK-003 - Specify scoped publication and recovery

Define operation permissions and a project-scoped publisher grant bound to actor, active execution/generation where applicable, exact record/content digest and expected version. Specify atomic single-record writes and a durable journal with pre/post hashes for supersession, correction and idempotent recovery.

| Field | Value |

| Status | `planned` |
| State reason | None |
| Skip authority | None |
| Requirements | REQ-006, REQ-007, REQ-009, REQ-018, REQ-020, REQ-021, REQ-022, REQ-023, REQ-024, REQ-025, REQ-026, REQ-058 |
| Design basis | None |
| Target artifacts | MEMORY-depo/publication-and-recovery.md, SKILLS-depo/memory/references/operations.md |
| Dependencies | TASK-002 |
| Parallel group | None |
| Completed at | None |

### Risks

- Cooperative publisher checks are not OS authentication; document the process/tool boundary and never treat a user-supplied actor string as sufficient authority.

### Acceptance criteria

- Director and confirmed manager grants are checked against actual current scope; a child can produce only a proposal.
- Journal recovery defines every interrupted commit boundary, preserves originals/reasons and cannot repair memory by replaying Task state.

### Planned verification

- Walk stale actor/version, concurrent human edit, supersession and sensitive-redaction examples through the contract.
- Review every named operation for input authority, writes, failure receipt and retry semantics.
